content: I wonder why the Sunflower went out of business? It got a great review and dining magazine, and every time I ate there, there was a big crowd.
It's not closed forever. There was a fire in the kitchen last month. But they planned to re-open as soon as the damage is repaired.
I'm glad to hear that. It was one of the best spots in town. It was so clean, the workers were so friendly and the food was great.
